cpuModelClass: Bun/JavaScriptCore synchronous algorithms, not native/Electron end-to-end latency; 100 samples + 10 warmups per case per arm, ABBA order, medians of two run summaries

startup.measurementClass: fresh process/profile, warm OS and server cache; DOM readiness polled at 50 ms, not a paint timestamp

limits: Native is a simulator, not physical iPhone/120 Hz/battery/thermal validation.
Native CADisplayLink measures main-run-loop callback cadence, not GPU presents.
Instruments simulator transport failed; failed .trace files are excluded. OS sample and VM summaries plus a separately injected native probe were used instead.
Native comparisons contain two complete baseline runs and one complete candidate run; interrupted/incomplete attempts are excluded.
Native native-script timings and CPU numbers varied; no native wall-time/energy speedup is claimed.
Startup DOM readiness can observe the initial fallback chat before active-agent restoration; startup data is exploratory, not a claimed startup win.
Heap snapshots are at different UI states; matched trace after-GC data and the candidate soak are used for memory comparisons.
No multi-hour soak, physical Android/Windows/Linux, or exhaustive large-document preview matrix.
